caption: The drawing consists of three vertical columns, each filled with horizontal bands featuring various geometric and floral patterns. The patterns utilize a wide range of colors, including shades of red, pink, blue, green, yellow, orange, purple, brown, and black. Each horizontal band within the columns displays a unique decorative motif, such as zigzags, intersecting lines, flowers, diamonds, and lattices. The background for each band varies in color and includes solid, gradient, and patterned designs. The columns are aligned parallel to one another and separated by white space. The name "Cordena Jackson" is written in small text in the bottom right corner. The overall composition is centered on a cream-colored background.
title: Feather Stitching
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
